global_caveats: No new models or benchmark accuracy were produced. All numerical outcomes explicitly attributed to papers.
SCIE/SCI journal indexing,year-specific coverage,quartile andimpact factors are not certified here; root should use Clarivate/publisher indexing proof rather than infer from English/DOI.
No directly verified acid-jujube THz multi-origin paper was found in this focused search; not proof none exists.

Not one accessible abstract establishes the desired combination of same-species growing-origin labels, independent-batch external validation and few-shot calibration. The last statement is an audit-scope limit, not a global novelty claim.
